name: waystone-v3
install: cd /workspace && set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a && uv sync --extra research && (cd frontend && npm install)

terminals.name: dash-api
terminals.command: cd /workspace && set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a && export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS="${GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS:-}" IBKR_REPORTS_BUCKET="${IBKR_REPORTS_BUCKET:-waystone-data}" WAYSTONE_DB="${WAYSTONE_DB:-/workspace/arena.db}" IBKR_STAGED=0 && .venv/bin/waystone3 api-serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 9200
terminals.description: HQ research API on port 9200 (GCS strategies + scorecards)

terminals.name: dash-ui
terminals.description: HQ Next.js UI on port 3001 — open /strategies after port forward

terminals.name: sentiment-daily
terminals.description: Daily sentiment fetch (FnG, Yahoo, SEC, GDELT, Massive news when MASSIVE_API_KEY is set)
